children: Indonesia new finance minister Suahazil Nazara said on Monday that President Prabowo Subianto has instructed him to safeguard the health and credibility of state finances.
He was told to get ready to serve as new finance minister just Monday morning, he said in he statement after his inauguration ceremony.
